We have a few questions for you regarding your presence in Grasslands Park one week ago Thursday.|Imperial Inquisitor Hydra to Sona Ziemba|<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception]]''</ref>}}
'''Grasslands Park''' was a public garden located on the northern outskirts of the [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was often crowded with [[Youngling/Legends|children]] and hosted the [[gingerbell blossom festival]]. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] of the young [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] first surfaced while she was playing in Grasslands Park.
